# scikit-plots-skinny

Dependency-free core of scikit-plots: the root package, logging and the scikitplot command line.

## Files in this directory

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `pyproject.toml` | Package metadata. Generated. |
| `setup.py` | Stages the owned files for the build. Generated. |
| `MANIFEST.in` | Contents of the source distribution. Generated. |
| `README_SKINNY.md` | Package description for the index. Generated. |

There is no copy of the source here. The build stages these paths from the repository's `scikitplot/` directory and removes them again:

- `scikitplot/_cli/`
- `scikitplot/logging/`
- `scikitplot/__init__.py`
- `scikitplot/__init__.pyi`
- `scikitplot/__main__.py`
- `scikitplot/_distributions.py`
- `scikitplot/environment_variables.py`
- `scikitplot/exceptions.py`
- `scikitplot/exceptions.pyi`
- `scikitplot/py.typed`

## Build and install

```sh
# from a local clone of the repository
pip install ./libs/skinny
python -m build libs/skinny

# straight from GitHub
pip install "git+https://github.com/scikit-plots/scikit-plots.git#subdirectory=libs/skinny"
```

To change what this distribution ships, edit `scikitplot/_distributions.py`; to change how it is packaged, edit `libs/_tools/registry.py`. Then run `python -m libs._tools generate`.
